integrity: The proof uses the published wheel facet-word classification, exact polarity, and a complete symbolic optimization of the centered polar norm by sign counts. The parity cases and equality conditions are proved for every m at once. The finite checker only corroborates the formulas and contact counts for small m.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the canonical Euclidean root-vector realization of wheel symmetric edge polytopes with outer cycle length at least five. It intentionally excludes the two small wheels that are complete multipartite. The literature comparison leaves a residual risk of an equivalent wheel-spread formula under different finite-metric terminology.
title: A parity law for the Euclidean inradius of wheel symmetric edge polytopes
